# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[commit]
	gpgsign = true
	verbose = true

[tag]
	gpgsign = true

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Network & HTTP
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[http]
	postBuffer = 524288000
	sslVerify = true

[url "git@github.com:"]
	insteadOf = https://github.com/

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Push / Pull / Fetch
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[push]
	default = current
	autoSetupRemote = true
	followTags = true

[pull]
	rebase = true

[fetch]
	prune = true
	prunetags = true
	parallel = 0
	writeCommitGraph = true

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge & Rebase
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[merge]
	conflictstyle = zdiff3

[rebase]

	autoStash = true

[rerere]
	enabled = true
	autoUpdate = true

[diff]
	algorithm = histogram

[status]
	aheadBehind = true
	showStash = true

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Branch & Column Display
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[branch]
	sort = -committerdate

[column]
	ui = auto

[log]
	date = iso

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Performance
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[feature]
	manyFiles = true

[pack]
	threads = 0

[checkout]
	workers = 0

[gc]
	writeCommitGraph = true

[index]
	sparse = true

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Filters (LFS & Media)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	clean = git-lfs clean -- %f
	smudge = git-lfs smudge -- %f
	required = true
	process = git-lfs filter-process

[filter "media"]

	clean = git media clean %f
	smudge = git media smudge %f

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Aliases
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[alias]
	# Status & Inspection
	st = status -sb
	last = log -1 HEAD --stat

	# Checkout & Branch (keeping your existing ones)

	sw = switch

	can = commit --amend --no-edit

	squash = commit --squash

	lds = log --pretty=format:"%C(yellow)%h\\ %ad%Cred%d\\ %Creset%s%Cblue\\ [%cn]" --decorate --date=short

# Kiro CLI pre block. Keep at the top of this file.
[[ -f "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.pre.zsh" ]] && builtin source "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.pre.zsh"

# Enable Powerlevel10k instant prompt. Should stay close to the top of ~/.zshrc.
# Initialization code that may require console input (password prompts, [y/n]
# confirmations, etc.) must go above this block; everything else may go below.
if [[ -r "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/p10k-instant-prompt-${(%):-%n}.zsh" ]]; then
  source "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/p10k-instant-prompt-${(%):-%n}.zsh"
fi

# If you come from bash you might have to change your $PATH.
# export PATH=$HOME/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH

# Path to your Oh My Zsh installation.
export ZSH="$HOME/.oh-my-zsh"

# Set name of the theme to load --- if set to "random", it will
# load a random theme each time Oh My Zsh is loaded, in which case,
# to know which specific one was loaded, run: echo $RANDOM_THEME
# See https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki/Themes
ZSH_THEME="powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k"

# Set list of themes to pick from when loading at random
# Setting this variable when ZSH_THEME=random will cause zsh to load
# a theme from this variable instead of looking in $ZSH/themes/
# If set to an empty array, this variable will have no effect.
# ZSH_THEME_RANDOM_CANDIDATES=( "robbyrussell" "agnoster" )

# Uncomment the following line to use case-sensitive completion.
# CASE_SENSITIVE="true"

# Uncomment the following line to use hyphen-insensitive completion.
# Case-sensitive completion must be off. _ and - will be interchangeable.
HYPHEN_INSENSITIVE="true"

# Uncomment one of the following lines to change the auto-update behavior
# zstyle ':omz:update' mode disabled  # disable automatic updates
zstyle ':omz:update' mode auto      # update automatically without asking
# zstyle ':omz:update' mode reminder  # just remind me to update when it's time

# Uncomment the following line to change how often to auto-update (in days).
zstyle ':omz:update' frequency 7

# Uncomment the following line if pasting URLs and other text is messed up.
# DISABLE_MAGIC_FUNCTIONS="true"

# Uncomment the following line to disable colors in ls.
# DISABLE_LS_COLORS="true"

# Uncomment the following line to disable auto-setting terminal title.
DISABLE_AUTO_TITLE="true"

# Uncomment the following line to enable command auto-correction.
ENABLE_CORRECTION="true"

# Uncomment the following line to display red dots whilst waiting for completion.
# You can also set it to another string to have that shown instead of the default red dots.
# e.g. COMPLETION_WAITING_DOTS="%F{yellow}waiting...%f"
# Caution: this setting can cause issues with multiline prompts in zsh < 5.7.1 (see #5765)
# COMPLETION_WAITING_DOTS="true"

# Uncomment the following line if you want to disable marking untracked files
# under VCS as dirty. This makes repository status check for large repositories
# much, much faster.
# DISABLE_UNTRACKED_FILES_DIRTY="true"

# Uncomment the following line if you want to change the command execution time
# stamp shown in the history command output.
# You can set one of the optional three formats:
# "mm/dd/yyyy"|"dd.mm.yyyy"|"yyyy-mm-dd"
# or set a custom format using the strftime function format specifications,
# see 'man strftime' for details.
HIST_STAMPS="mm/dd/yyyy"
HISTSIZE=999999999
HISTFILE="$HOME/.local/shell/.zsh_history"
SAVEHIST=$HISTSIZE
# there is for sure still some redundancy, but ...
# setopt BANG_HIST                 # Treat the '!' character specially during expansion.
setopt EXTENDED_HISTORY          # Write the history file in the ":start:elapsed;command" format.
# setopt INC_APPEND_HISTORY        # Write to the history file immediately, not when the shell exits.
setopt SHARE_HISTORY             # Share history between all sessions.
setopt share_history
setopt HIST_EXPIRE_DUPS_FIRST    # Expire duplicate entries first when trimming history.
setopt HIST_IGNORE_DUPS          # Don't record an entry that was just recorded again.
setopt HIST_IGNORE_ALL_DUPS      # Delete old recorded entry if new entry is a duplicate.
setopt HIST_FIND_NO_DUPS         # Do not display a line previously found.
setopt HIST_IGNORE_SPACE         # Don't record an entry starting with a space.
setopt HIST_SAVE_NO_DUPS         # Don't write duplicate entries in the history file.
setopt HIST_REDUCE_BLANKS        # Remove superfluous blanks before recording entry.
#setopt HIST_VERIFY               # Don't execute immediately upon history expansion.
setopt HIST_BEEP                 # Beep when accessing nonexistent history.
alias history="history 0"

# Would you like to use another custom folder than $ZSH/custom?
# ZSH_CUSTOM=/path/to/new-custom-folder

PROMPT_EOL_MARK=''

# Which plugins would you like to load?
# Standard plugins can be found in $ZSH/plugins/
# Custom plugins may be added to $ZSH_CUSTOM/plugins/
# Example format: plugins=(rails git textmate ruby lighthouse)
# Add wisely, as too many plugins slow down shell startup.
plugins=(
  brew
  colorize 
  dotenv
  git 
  git-extras 
  sudo
  zoxide
  )

source $ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh

# User configuration
export HOME="/Users/rambhiad"
export PYTHON="/usr/bin/python3"
export OPENSSL="/usr/local/opt/openssl/bin"
export OPENSSH="/usr/local/bin/ssh:/usr/local/bin/ssh-add:/usr/local/bin/ssh-agent:/usr/local/bin/ssh-keygen:/usr/local/bin/ssh-keyscan:/usr/local/bin/sshfs"
export CURL="/usr/local/opt/curl/bin"
export GOPATH="$HOME/go"
export RUSTBIN="$HOME/.cargo/bin"
export PACTPATH="$HOME/.local/pact/bin"
export KREW_ROOT="$HOME/.krew"
export CODEQL_CLI="$HOME/.local/codeql"
export M2_HOME="$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current"

export PATH="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
export PATH="$CURL:$PATH:$PYTHON:$OPENSSL:$OPENSSH:$GOPATH/bin:$RUSTBIN"
export PATH="$PATH:$JAVA_HOME:$PACTPATH"
export PATH="$PATH:/Users/rambhiad/.local/bin"
export PATH="$PATH:$KREW_ROOT/bin"
export PATH="$PATH:$CODEQL_CLI"
export PATH="$PATH:$M2_HOME/bin"
source $ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh

# export MANPATH="/usr/local/man:$MANPATH"

# You may need to manually set your language environment
# export LANG=en_US.UTF-8

# Preferred editor for local and remote sessions
if [[ -n $SSH_CONNECTION ]]; then
  export EDITOR='vim'
else
  export EDITOR='code --wait'
fi


if [[ $TERM_PROGRAM != "WarpTerminal" ]]; then
  # eval "$(oh-my-posh init zsh --config $(brew --prefix oh-my-posh)/themes/atomic.omp.json)"
  test -e "${HOME}/.iterm2_shell_integration.zsh" && source "${HOME}/.iterm2_shell_integration.zsh"
fi


#Autocomplete for aws cli
if type aws_completer > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  complete -C "$(which aws_completer)" aws
fi

if command -v pyenv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH"
  export PYENV_ROOT="$HOME/.pyenv"
  eval "$(pyenv init -)"
fi


# Set personal aliases, overriding those provided by oh-my-zsh libs,
# plugins, and themes. Aliases can be placed here, though oh-my-zsh
# users are encouraged to define aliases within the ZSH_CUSTOM folder.
# For a full list of active aliases, run `alias`.
source $HOME/.local/shell/.aliases

# Q post block. Keep at the bottom of this file.
source /Users/rambhiad/.callerfile.sh
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/Users/rambhiad/ca-certs/Zscaler-Root-CA.pem

# The following lines have been added by Docker Desktop to enable Docker CLI completions.
fpath=(/Users/rambhiad/.docker/completions $fpath)
autoload -Uz compinit
compinit

# To customize prompt, run `p10k configure` or edit ~/.p10k.zsh.
[[ ! -f $HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh ]] || source $HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh

export _ZO_DATA_DIR=$HOME/.local/share/zoxide
export _ZO_CACHE_DIR=$HOME/.cache/zoxide
export _ZO_ECHO=1
export _ZO_RESOLVE_SYMLINKS=1
eval "$(zoxide init --cmd z zsh)"

#THIS MUST BE AT THE END OF THE FILE FOR SDKMAN TO WORK!!!
export SDKMAN_DIR="$HOME/.sdkman"
[[ -s "$HOME/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh" ]] && source "$HOME/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"

# To customize prompt, run `p10k configure` or edit ~/.p10k.zsh.
[[ ! -f ~/.p10k.zsh ]] || source ~/.p10k.zsh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"


# SSL Certificate Configuration for Zscaler
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"
export SSL_CERT_FILE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"
export CURL_CA_BUNDLE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"


# Added by Antigravity
export PATH="/Users/rambhiad/.antigravity/antigravity/bin:$PATH"


# Kiro CLI post block. Keep at the bottom of this file.
[[ -f "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.post.zsh" ]] && builtin source "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.post.zsh"

# =============================================================================
export ZSH="$HOME/.oh-my-zsh"
ZSH_THEME="powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k"

# Oh My Zsh settings
HYPHEN_INSENSITIVE="true"
DISABLE_AUTO_TITLE="true"
ENABLE_CORRECTION="true"
PROMPT_EOL_MARK=''

# Update settings
zstyle ':omz:update' mode auto
zstyle ':omz:update' frequency 7

# Plugins (keep minimal for performance)
plugins=(
  brew
  colorize
  dotenv
  git
  git-extras
  sudo
  zoxide
)

source $ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh

# =============================================================================
# History Configuration
# =============================================================================
# HISTFILE is set in .zshenv for XDG compliance
HISTSIZE=999999999
SAVEHIST=$HISTSIZE
HIST_STAMPS="yyyy-mm-dd"

setopt EXTENDED_HISTORY          # Write timestamp to history
setopt SHARE_HISTORY             # Share history between sessions
setopt HIST_EXPIRE_DUPS_FIRST    # Expire duplicates first
setopt HIST_IGNORE_DUPS          # Don't record duplicates
setopt HIST_IGNORE_ALL_DUPS      # Delete old duplicate entries
setopt HIST_FIND_NO_DUPS         # Don't display duplicates when searching
setopt HIST_IGNORE_SPACE         # Don't record entries starting with space
setopt HIST_SAVE_NO_DUPS         # Don't write duplicates to file
setopt HIST_REDUCE_BLANKS        # Remove superfluous blanks
setopt HIST_BEEP                 # Beep on nonexistent history

alias history="history 0"

# =============================================================================
# Additional PATH entries (base PATH is in .zshenv)
# =============================================================================
# Tool-specific paths not covered by XDG
path+=(
  "$HOME/.krew/bin"
  "$HOME/.local/pact/bin"
  "$HOME/.local/codeql"
  "$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin"
  "$HOME/.antigravity/antigravity/bin"
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/Toolbox/scripts"
  "$HOME/.tfenv/bin"
  "/usr/local/opt/curl/bin"
  "/usr/local/opt/openssl/bin"
)
export PATH

# =============================================================================
# SSL Certificate Configuration (Zscaler)
# =============================================================================
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"
export SSL_CERT_FILE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"
export CURL_CA_BUNDLE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"

# Additional certificate setup
[[ -f "$HOME/.callerfile.sh" ]] && source "$HOME/.callerfile.sh"

# =============================================================================
# Completion System (optimized)
# =============================================================================
# Add Docker completions to fpath
fpath=($HOME/.docker/completions $fpath)

# Only regenerate completion dump once per day
autoload -Uz compinit
if [[ -n ${ZDOTDIR:-$HOME}/.zcompdump(#qN.mh+24) ]]; then
  compinit
else
  compinit -C
fi

# Completion styling
zstyle ':completion:*' use-cache on
zstyle ':completion:*' cache-path "$XDG_CACHE_HOME/zsh/zcompcache"

# =============================================================================
# Tool Initializations (lazy loaded for performance)
# =============================================================================

# Pyenv - lazy load (saves ~50ms)
if [[ -d "$HOME/.pyenv" ]]; then
  export PYENV_ROOT="$HOME/.pyenv"

  _load_pyenv() {
    unset -f pyenv python python3 pip pip3
    export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH"
    eval "$(command pyenv init -)"
  }

  pyenv() { _load_pyenv && pyenv "$@"; }
  python() { _load_pyenv && python "$@"; }
  python3() { _load_pyenv && python3 "$@"; }
  pip() { _load_pyenv && pip "$@"; }
  pip3() { _load_pyenv && pip3 "$@"; }
fi

# SDKMAN - lazy load (saves ~100ms)
if [[ -d "$HOME/.sdkman" ]]; then
  export SDKMAN_DIR="$HOME/.sdkman"

  _load_sdkman() {
    unset -f sdk java javac mvn gradle
    [[ -s "$SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh" ]] && source "$SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh"
  }

  sdk() { _load_sdkman && sdk "$@"; }
  java() { _load_sdkman && java "$@"; }
  javac() { _load_sdkman && javac "$@"; }
  mvn() { _load_sdkman && mvn "$@"; }
  gradle() { _load_sdkman && gradle "$@"; }
fi

# =============================================================================
# AWS CLI Completion
# =============================================================================
if (( $+commands[aws_completer] )); then
  complete -C aws_completer aws
fi

# =============================================================================
# Zoxide Configuration
# =============================================================================
export _ZO_ECHO=1
export _ZO_RESOLVE_SYMLINKS=1
eval "$(zoxide init --cmd z zsh)"

# =============================================================================
# iTerm2 Integration
# =============================================================================
if [[ $TERM_PROGRAM != "WarpTerminal" ]]; then
  [[ -e "${HOME}/.iterm2_shell_integration.zsh" ]] && source "${HOME}/.iterm2_shell_integration.zsh"
fi

# =============================================================================
# Custom Aliases
# =============================================================================
[[ -f "$HOME/.local/shell/.aliases" ]] && source "$HOME/.local/shell/.aliases"

# =============================================================================
# Powerlevel10k Theme
# =============================================================================
[[ -f "$HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh" ]] && source "$HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh"

# =============================================================================
# Kiro CLI post block. Keep at the bottom of this file.
# =============================================================================
[[ -f "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.post.zsh" ]] && builtin source "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.post.zsh"

# =============================================================================
# Custom Shell Aliases and Functions
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# Cleanup Aliases
# =============================================================================
alias rmdsstores='find . -type f -name ".DS_Store" -delete'
alias rmtellog='find . -type f -name "telepresence.log" -delete'

# =============================================================================
# Kubernetes
# =============================================================================
alias k='nocorrect kubecolor'
compdef kubecolor=kubectl
compdef k=kubectl

# =============================================================================
# Terraform
# =============================================================================
complete -o nospace -C /opt/homebrew/bin/terraform terraform
alias t='terraform'
alias tf='terraform'
alias tfi='terraform init'
alias tfp='terraform plan'
alias tfa='terraform apply'
alias tfd='terraform destroy'
compdef t=terraform
compdef tf=terraform

# =============================================================================
# AWS
# =============================================================================
if [[ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/aws-sso-util" ]]; then
  eval "$(_AWS_SSO_UTIL_COMPLETE=zsh_source $HOME/.local/bin/aws-sso-util)"
fi
alias awsd="source _awsd"

# =============================================================================
# Modern CLI Replacements
# =============================================================================
# ls -> eza
alias ls='eza --icons --group-directories-first'
alias ll='eza --long --all --grid --classify --icons --group-directories-first'
alias la='eza --all --icons --classify --group-directories-first'
alias l='eza --long --icons --all'
alias lt='eza --tree --icons'
alias lta='eza --tree --icons --all'
alias ltl='eza --tree --icons --long'

# cat -> bat
alias cat='bat --paging=always --theme=zenburn'
alias catp='bat --plain'  # No line numbers, no paging

# =============================================================================
# Git Shortcuts (complements .gitconfig aliases)
# =============================================================================
alias g='git'
alias gs='git status -sb'
alias gd='git diff'
alias gds='git diff --staged'
alias gl='git log --oneline -15'
alias gp='git push'
alias gpl='git pull --rebase'
alias gco='git checkout'
alias gcb='git checkout -b'
alias gcp='git cherry-pick'

# =============================================================================
# Navigation
# =============================================================================
alias ..='cd ..'
alias ...='cd ../..'
alias ....='cd ../../..'
alias ~='cd ~'
alias -- -='cd -'

# =============================================================================
# Safety
# =============================================================================
alias rm='rm -i'
alias mv='mv -i'
alias cp='cp -i'

# =============================================================================
# Tailscale
# =============================================================================
alias tailscale="/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale"

# Generate completions only if missing
if [[ ! -f "${fpath[1]}/_tailscale" ]] && [[ -x "/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale" ]]; then
  /Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_tailscale" 2>/dev/null
fi

# =============================================================================
# Miscellaneous
# =============================================================================
alias reload='source ~/.zshrc'
alias path='echo -e ${PATH//:/\\n}'
alias ports='lsof -i -P -n | grep LISTEN'
alias ip='curl -s ifconfig.me'
alias localip='ipconfig getifaddr en0'
alias flushdns='sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder'

# =============================================================================
# Functions
# =============================================================================
function set_win_title() {
  echo -ne "\033]0; $(basename "$PWD") \007"
}

# Create directory and cd into it
function mkcd() {
  mkdir -p "$1" && cd "$1"
}

# Extract various archive formats
function extract() {
  if [[ -f "$1" ]]; then
    case "$1" in
      *.tar.bz2) tar xjf "$1" ;;
      *.tar.gz)  tar xzf "$1" ;;
      *.tar.xz)  tar xJf "$1" ;;
      *.bz2)     bunzip2 "$1" ;;
      *.gz)      gunzip "$1" ;;
      *.tar)     tar xf "$1" ;;
      *.tbz2)    tar xjf "$1" ;;
      *.tgz)     tar xzf "$1" ;;
      *.zip)     unzip "$1" ;;
      *.Z)       uncompress "$1" ;;
      *.7z)      7z x "$1" ;;
      *.rar)     unrar x "$1" ;;
      *)         echo "'$1' cannot be extracted via extract()" ;;
    esac
  else
    echo "'$1' is not a valid file"
  fi
}

# =============================================================================
# ~/.zshrc - Interactive Shell Configuration
# =============================================================================
# Note: Environment variables are now in ~/.zshenv (XDG compliant)

# Kiro CLI pre block. Keep at the top of this file.
[[ -f "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.pre.zsh" ]] && builtin source "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.pre.zsh"

# =============================================================================
# Powerlevel10k Instant Prompt (must be near top, after Kiro pre block)
# =============================================================================
if [[ -r "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/p10k-instant-prompt-${(%):-%n}.zsh" ]]; then
  source "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/p10k-instant-prompt-${(%):-%n}.zsh"
fi

# =============================================================================
# Plugin Manager Selection: zinit (testing) vs Oh My Zsh (fallback)
# =============================================================================
# Set to "zinit" to use zinit, or "omz" to use Oh My Zsh
PLUGIN_MANAGER="zinit"

if [[ "$PLUGIN_MANAGER" == "zinit" ]]; then
  # ===========================================================================
  # ZINIT Configuration (Turbo Mode - faster startup)
  # ===========================================================================
  ZINIT_HOME="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-${HOME}/.local/share}/zinit/zinit.git"

  # Auto-install zinit if not present
  if [[ ! -d "$ZINIT_HOME" ]]; then
    print -P "%F{33}Installing zinit...%f"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname $ZINIT_HOME)"
    git clone https://github.com/zdharma-continuum/zinit.git "$ZINIT_HOME"
  fi

  source "${ZINIT_HOME}/zinit.zsh"

  # Load Powerlevel10k immediately (needed for prompt)
  zinit ice depth=1
  zinit light romkatv/powerlevel10k

  # Turbo Mode: Load these plugins AFTER prompt appears (wait'0')
  # This makes your shell appear instantly, plugins load in background

  # Completions - load first for other plugins to use
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid blockf atpull'zinit creinstall -q .'
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-completions

  # Autosuggestions - fish-like suggestions
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid atload'_zsh_autosuggest_start'
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions

  # Syntax highlighting - must be loaded after completions
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid atinit'zicompinit; zicdreplay'
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting

  # History substring search (up/down arrow searches history)
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-history-substring-search

  # Oh My Zsh plugins loaded via zinit (cherry-pick what you need)
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid
  zinit snippet OMZP::git

  zinit ice wait'0' lucid
  zinit snippet OMZP::sudo

  zinit ice wait'1' lucid  # Slightly delayed - less critical
  zinit snippet OMZP::colored-man-pages

  # Zoxide (if not using system zoxide)
  # zinit ice wait'0' lucid
  # zinit light ajeetdsouza/zoxide

  # Key bindings for history-substring-search
  bindkey '^[[A' history-substring-search-up
  bindkey '^[[B' history-substring-search-down

else
  # ===========================================================================
  # OH MY ZSH Configuration (fallback - comment out zinit section above)
  # ===========================================================================
  export ZSH="$HOME/.oh-my-zsh"
  ZSH_THEME="powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k"

  # Oh My Zsh settings
  HYPHEN_INSENSITIVE="true"
  DISABLE_AUTO_TITLE="true"
  ENABLE_CORRECTION="true"
  PROMPT_EOL_MARK=''

  # Update settings
  zstyle ':omz:update' mode auto
  zstyle ':omz:update' frequency 7

  # Plugins (keep minimal for performance)
  plugins=(
    brew
    colorize
    dotenv
    git
    git-extras
    sudo
    zoxide
  )

  source $ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh
fi

# =============================================================================
# History Configuration
# =============================================================================
# HISTFILE is set in .zshenv for XDG compliance
HISTSIZE=999999999
SAVEHIST=$HISTSIZE
HIST_STAMPS="yyyy-mm-dd"

setopt EXTENDED_HISTORY          # Write timestamp to history
setopt SHARE_HISTORY             # Share history between sessions
setopt HIST_EXPIRE_DUPS_FIRST    # Expire duplicates first
setopt HIST_IGNORE_DUPS          # Don't record duplicates
setopt HIST_IGNORE_ALL_DUPS      # Delete old duplicate entries
setopt HIST_FIND_NO_DUPS         # Don't display duplicates when searching
setopt HIST_IGNORE_SPACE         # Don't record entries starting with space
setopt HIST_SAVE_NO_DUPS         # Don't write duplicates to file
setopt HIST_REDUCE_BLANKS        # Remove superfluous blanks
setopt HIST_BEEP                 # Beep on nonexistent history

alias history="history 0"

# =============================================================================
# Shell Options
# =============================================================================
setopt AUTO_CD                   # cd by typing directory name
setopt AUTO_PUSHD                # Push directories onto stack
setopt PUSHD_IGNORE_DUPS         # Don't push duplicates
setopt PUSHD_SILENT              # Don't print stack after push/pop
setopt INTERACTIVE_COMMENTS      # Allow comments in interactive shell
setopt NO_BEEP                   # Disable beep on errors

# =============================================================================
# Additional PATH entries (base PATH is in .zshenv)
# =============================================================================

path+=(
  "$HOME/.krew/bin"
  "$HOME/.local/pact/bin"
  "$HOME/.local/codeql"
  "$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin"
  "$HOME/.antigravity/antigravity/bin"

export SSL_CERT_FILE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"

# =============================================================================

# Pyenv - lazy load (saves ~50ms)
if [[ -d "$HOME/.pyenv" ]]; then
  export PYENV_ROOT="$HOME/.pyenv"

  _load_pyenv() {

  pip() { _load_pyenv && pip "$@"; }
  pip3() { _load_pyenv && pip3 "$@"; }
fi

  export SDKMAN_DIR="$HOME/.sdkman"

  _load_sdkman() {
    unset -f sdk java javac mvn gradle
    [[ -s "$SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh" ]] && source "$SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh"

  javac() { _load_sdkman && javac "$@"; }
  mvn() { _load_sdkman && mvn "$@"; }

# =============================================================================

  complete -C aws_completer aws
fi

# Zoxide Configuration
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# ~/.zshrc - Interactive Shell Configuration
# =============================================================================
# Note: Environment variables are now in ~/.zshenv (XDG compliant)

# Kiro CLI pre block. Keep at the top of this file.
[[ -f "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.pre.zsh" ]] && builtin source "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.pre.zsh"

# =============================================================================
# Powerlevel10k Instant Prompt (must be near top, after Kiro pre block)
# =============================================================================
if [[ -r "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/p10k-instant-prompt-${(%):-%n}.zsh" ]]; then
  source "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/p10k-instant-prompt-${(%):-%n}.zsh"
fi

# =============================================================================
# Plugin Manager Selection: zinit (testing) vs Oh My Zsh (fallback)
# =============================================================================
# Set to "zinit" to use zinit, or "omz" to use Oh My Zsh
PLUGIN_MANAGER="zinit"

if [[ "$PLUGIN_MANAGER" == "zinit" ]]; then
  # ===========================================================================
  # ZINIT Configuration (Turbo Mode - faster startup)
  # ===========================================================================
  ZINIT_HOME="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-${HOME}/.local/share}/zinit/zinit.git"

  # Auto-install zinit if not present
  if [[ ! -d "$ZINIT_HOME" ]]; then
    print -P "%F{33}Installing zinit...%f"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname $ZINIT_HOME)"
    git clone https://github.com/zdharma-continuum/zinit.git "$ZINIT_HOME"
  fi

  source "${ZINIT_HOME}/zinit.zsh"

  # Load Powerlevel10k immediately (needed for prompt)
  zinit ice depth=1
  zinit light romkatv/powerlevel10k

  # Turbo Mode: Load these plugins AFTER prompt appears (wait'0')
  # This makes your shell appear instantly, plugins load in background

  # Completions - load first for other plugins to use
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid blockf atpull'zinit creinstall -q .'
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-completions

  # Autosuggestions - fish-like suggestions
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid atload'_zsh_autosuggest_start'
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions

  # Syntax highlighting - must be loaded after completions
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid atinit'zicompinit; zicdreplay'
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting

  # History substring search (up/down arrow searches history)
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-history-substring-search

  # Oh My Zsh plugins loaded via zinit (cherry-pick what you need)
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid
  zinit snippet OMZP::git

  zinit ice wait'0' lucid
  zinit snippet OMZP::sudo

  zinit ice wait'1' lucid  # Slightly delayed - less critical
  zinit snippet OMZP::colored-man-pages

  # Zoxide (if not using system zoxide)
  # zinit ice wait'0' lucid
  # zinit light ajeetdsouza/zoxide

  # Key bindings for history-substring-search
  bindkey '^[[A' history-substring-search-up
  bindkey '^[[B' history-substring-search-down

else
  # ===========================================================================
  # OH MY ZSH Configuration (fallback - comment out zinit section above)
  # ===========================================================================
  export ZSH="$HOME/.oh-my-zsh"
  ZSH_THEME="powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k"

  # Oh My Zsh settings
  HYPHEN_INSENSITIVE="true"
  DISABLE_AUTO_TITLE="true"
  ENABLE_CORRECTION="true"
  PROMPT_EOL_MARK=''

  # Update settings
  zstyle ':omz:update' mode auto
  zstyle ':omz:update' frequency 7

  # Plugins (keep minimal for performance)
  plugins=(
    brew
    colorize
    dotenv
    git
    git-extras
    sudo
    zoxide
  )

  source $ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh
fi

# =============================================================================
# History Configuration
# =============================================================================
# HISTFILE is set in .zshenv for XDG compliance
HISTSIZE=999999999
SAVEHIST=$HISTSIZE
HIST_STAMPS="yyyy-mm-dd"

setopt EXTENDED_HISTORY          # Write timestamp to history
setopt SHARE_HISTORY             # Share history between sessions
setopt HIST_EXPIRE_DUPS_FIRST    # Expire duplicates first
setopt HIST_IGNORE_DUPS          # Don't record duplicates
setopt HIST_IGNORE_ALL_DUPS      # Delete old duplicate entries
setopt HIST_FIND_NO_DUPS         # Don't display duplicates when searching
setopt HIST_IGNORE_SPACE         # Don't record entries starting with space
setopt HIST_SAVE_NO_DUPS         # Don't write duplicates to file
setopt HIST_REDUCE_BLANKS        # Remove superfluous blanks
setopt HIST_BEEP                 # Beep on nonexistent history

alias history="history 0"

# =============================================================================
# Shell Options
# =============================================================================
setopt AUTO_CD                   # cd by typing directory name
setopt AUTO_PUSHD                # Push directories onto stack
setopt PUSHD_IGNORE_DUPS         # Don't push duplicates
setopt PUSHD_SILENT              # Don't print stack after push/pop
setopt INTERACTIVE_COMMENTS      # Allow comments in interactive shell
setopt NO_BEEP                   # Disable beep on errors

# =============================================================================
# Additional PATH entries (base PATH is in .zshenv)
# =============================================================================
# Tool-specific paths not covered by XDG
path+=(
  "$HOME/.krew/bin"
  "$HOME/.local/pact/bin"
  "$HOME/.local/codeql"
  "$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin"
  "$HOME/.antigravity/antigravity/bin"
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/Toolbox/scripts"
  "$HOME/.tfenv/bin"
  "/usr/local/opt/curl/bin"
  "/usr/local/opt/openssl/bin"
)
export PATH

# =============================================================================
# SSL Certificate Configuration (Zscaler)
# =============================================================================
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"
export SSL_CERT_FILE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"
export CURL_CA_BUNDLE="/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem"

# Additional certificate setup
[[ -f "$HOME/.callerfile.sh" ]] && source "$HOME/.callerfile.sh"

# =============================================================================
# Completion System (for non-zinit setup or additional completions)
# =============================================================================
# Add Docker completions to fpath
fpath=($HOME/.docker/completions $fpath)

# Only run compinit if not using zinit (zinit handles this)
if [[ "$PLUGIN_MANAGER" != "zinit" ]]; then
  autoload -Uz compinit
  if [[ -n ${ZDOTDIR:-$HOME}/.zcompdump(#qN.mh+24) ]]; then
    compinit
  else
    compinit -C
  fi
fi

# Completion styling
zstyle ':completion:*' use-cache on
zstyle ':completion:*' cache-path "$XDG_CACHE_HOME/zsh/zcompcache"
zstyle ':completion:*' matcher-list 'm:{a-zA-Z}={A-Za-z}'  # Case insensitive
zstyle ':completion:*' menu select
zstyle ':completion:*' list-colors "${(s.:.)LS_COLORS}"

# =============================================================================
# Tool Initializations (lazy loaded for performance)
# =============================================================================

# Pyenv - lazy load (saves ~50ms)
if [[ -d "$HOME/.pyenv" ]]; then
  export PYENV_ROOT="$HOME/.pyenv"

  _load_pyenv() {
    unset -f pyenv python python3 pip pip3
    export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH"
    eval "$(command pyenv init -)"
  }

  pyenv() { _load_pyenv && pyenv "$@"; }
  python() { _load_pyenv && python "$@"; }
  python3() { _load_pyenv && python3 "$@"; }
  pip() { _load_pyenv && pip "$@"; }
  pip3() { _load_pyenv && pip3 "$@"; }
fi

# SDKMAN - lazy load (saves ~100ms)
if [[ -d "$HOME/.sdkman" ]]; then
  export SDKMAN_DIR="$HOME/.sdkman"

  _load_sdkman() {
    unset -f sdk java javac mvn gradle
    [[ -s "$SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh" ]] && source "$SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh"
  }

  sdk() { _load_sdkman && sdk "$@"; }
  java() { _load_sdkman && java "$@"; }
  javac() { _load_sdkman && javac "$@"; }
  mvn() { _load_sdkman && mvn "$@"; }
  gradle() { _load_sdkman && gradle "$@"; }
fi

# =============================================================================
# AWS CLI Completion
# =============================================================================
if (( $+commands[aws_completer] )); then
  complete -C aws_completer aws
fi

# =============================================================================
# Zoxide Configuration
# =============================================================================
export _ZO_ECHO=1
export _ZO_RESOLVE_SYMLINKS=1
eval "$(zoxide init --cmd z zsh)"

# =============================================================================
# iTerm2 Integration
# =============================================================================
if [[ $TERM_PROGRAM != "WarpTerminal" ]]; then
  [[ -e "${HOME}/.iterm2_shell_integration.zsh" ]] && source "${HOME}/.iterm2_shell_integration.zsh"
fi

# =============================================================================
# Custom Aliases
# =============================================================================
[[ -f "$HOME/.local/shell/.aliases" ]] && source "$HOME/.local/shell/.aliases"

# =============================================================================
# Powerlevel10k Theme
# =============================================================================
[[ -f "$HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh" ]] && source "$HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh"

# =============================================================================
# Kiro CLI post block. Keep at the bottom of this file.
# =============================================================================
[[ -f "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.post.zsh" ]] && builtin source "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.post.zsh"

alias tfa='terraform apply'

alias l='eza --long --icons --all'

alias lta='eza --tree --icons --all'
alias ltl='eza --tree --icons --long'

alias gpl='git pull --rebase'
alias gco='git checkout'
alias gcb='git checkout -b'

# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================

alias ...='cd ../..'

alias ~='cd ~'
alias -- -='cd -'

# =============================================================================

  echo -ne "\033]0; $(basename "$PWD") \007"
}

  mkdir -p "$1" && cd "$1"
}

# Extract various archive formats
function extract() {
  if [[ -f "$1" ]]; then
    case "$1" in
      *.tar.bz2) tar xjf "$1" ;;
      *.tar.gz)  tar xzf "$1" ;;
      *.tar.xz)  tar xJf "$1" ;;
      *.bz2)     bunzip2 "$1" ;;
      *.gz)      gunzip "$1" ;;
      *.tar)     tar xf "$1" ;;
      *.tbz2)    tar xjf "$1" ;;
      *.tgz)     tar xzf "$1" ;;
      *.zip)     unzip "$1" ;;
      *.Z)       uncompress "$1" ;;

The errors are now:
1. zinit compile hook warning - not critical, just a warning
2. `complete:13: command not found: compdef` - this is strange, it seems like `compdef` is being called inside the `complete` command context, which doesn't make sense

The "complete:13: command not found: compdef" suggests that the bash `complete` command is somehow trying to run `compdef`. This is weird because `complete` is bash's completion system and `compdef` is zsh's.

Looking at the aliases file, I have:
```zsh
if (( $+commands[terraform] )); then
  autoload -Uz bashcompinit && bashcompinit
  complete -o nospace -C /opt/homebrew/bin/terraform terraform
fi
```

The issue might be that `bashcompinit` creates a `complete` function that then tries to call `compdef`. Let me check - yes, `bashcompinit` does create a `complete` function that wraps things for zsh compatibility, and it internally uses `compdef`.

The problem is that `compdef` doesn't exist yet when this runs because zinit's turbo mode delays `compinit`. The aliases file is sourced before zinit's turbo-loaded plugins run `zicompinit`.

The solution is to either:
1. Move the terraform/AWS completion setup to run after compinit
2. Or wrap them in a function that runs later
3. Or don't use bashcompinit and use native zsh completion instead

Let me fix this by moving the bashcompinit-dependent completions to a zinit ice that runs after compinit.

# =============================================================================
# ~/.zshenv - Environment Variables (loaded for ALL zsh instances)
# =============================================================================
# This file is loaded first, before .zprofile, .zshrc, and .zlogin
# Only put environment variables here - no interactive shell config

# =============================================================================
# XDG Base Directory Specification
# =============================================================================
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}"
export XDG_DATA_HOME="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}"
export XDG_STATE_HOME="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}"

# Create XDG directories if they don't exist
[[ -d "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME" ]] || mkdir -p "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
[[ -d "$XDG_DATA_HOME" ]] || mkdir -p "$XDG_DATA_HOME"
[[ -d "$XDG_STATE_HOME" ]] || mkdir -p "$XDG_STATE_HOME"
[[ -d "$XDG_CACHE_HOME" ]] || mkdir -p "$XDG_CACHE_HOME"

# =============================================================================
# Zsh XDG Compliance
# =============================================================================
# Note: ZDOTDIR would move .zshrc to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/zsh/.zshrc
# Uncomment the following line if you want to migrate .zshrc location:
# export ZDOTDIR="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/zsh"

# Zsh state files (history, completion cache)
export HISTFILE="$XDG_STATE_HOME/zsh/history"
[[ -d "$XDG_STATE_HOME/zsh" ]] || mkdir -p "$XDG_STATE_HOME/zsh"

# =============================================================================
# Development Tools - XDG Compliance
# =============================================================================
# Rust
export CARGO_HOME="$XDG_DATA_HOME/cargo"
export RUSTUP_HOME="$XDG_DATA_HOME/rustup"

# Go
export GOPATH="$XDG_DATA_HOME/go"
export GOMODCACHE="$XDG_CACHE_HOME/go/mod"

# Node.js / npm
export NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/npm/npmrc"
export NODE_REPL_HISTORY="$XDG_STATE_HOME/node_repl_history"

# Python
export PYTHONSTARTUP="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/python/pythonrc"
export PYLINTHOME="$XDG_CACHE_HOME/pylint"
export IPYTHONDIR="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ipython"
export JUPYTER_CONFIG_DIR="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/jupyter"

# =============================================================================
# CLI Tools - XDG Compliance
# =============================================================================
# Less
export LESSHISTFILE="$XDG_STATE_HOME/less/history"
[[ -d "$XDG_STATE_HOME/less" ]] || mkdir -p "$XDG_STATE_HOME/less"

# GNU Readline
export INPUTRC="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/readline/inputrc"

# wget
export WGETRC="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/wgetrc"

# Docker
export DOCKER_CONFIG="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/docker"

# GnuPG
export GNUPGHOME="$XDG_DATA_HOME/gnupg"

# =============================================================================
# Cloud & DevOps Tools
# =============================================================================
# AWS
export AWS_CONFIG_FILE="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/aws/config"
export AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/aws/credentials"

# Kubernetes
export KUBECONFIG="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/kube/config"

# Terraform
export TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/terraform/terraformrc"

# =============================================================================
# Database Histories
# =============================================================================
export MYSQL_HISTFILE="$XDG_STATE_HOME/mysql_history"
export PSQL_HISTORY="$XDG_STATE_HOME/psql_history"
export SQLITE_HISTORY="$XDG_STATE_HOME/sqlite_history"
export REDISCLI_HISTFILE="$XDG_STATE_HOME/redis/rediscli_history"

# =============================================================================
# macOS / Homebrew
# =============================================================================
export HOMEBREW_CACHE="$XDG_CACHE_HOME/homebrew"
export HOMEBREW_LOGS="$XDG_STATE_HOME/homebrew/logs"

# =============================================================================
# Zoxide
# =============================================================================
export _ZO_DATA_DIR="$XDG_DATA_HOME/zoxide"
export _ZO_CACHE_DIR="$XDG_CACHE_HOME/zoxide"

# =============================================================================
# Editor
# =============================================================================
export EDITOR='code --wait'
export VISUAL='code --wait'

# =============================================================================
# PATH Construction (order matters: first match wins)
# =============================================================================
# Use typeset -U to ensure unique entries
typeset -U path

# Build PATH with XDG-compliant locations
path=(
    "$HOME/.local/bin"
    "$CARGO_HOME/bin"
    "$GOPATH/bin"
    "/opt/homebrew/bin"
    "/opt/homebrew/sbin"
    "/usr/local/bin"
    "/usr/local/sbin"
    "/usr/bin"
    "/bin"
    "/usr/sbin"
    "/sbin"
    $path
)

export PATH

content.text:
Good question! Here's how it works:

## SSH Signing vs GPG Signing

| Aspect | Your Current Setup (GPG) | SSH Signing |
|--------|-------------------------|-------------|
| Keys used | GPG keys (separate from SSH) | Your existing SSH keys |
| Your existing GPG-signed commits | ✅ Remain valid forever | ✅ Still valid |
| Your existing SSH key | Used for auth only | Used for auth + signing |

## The Good News

- **No new keys needed** - You can use your existing `~/.ssh/github_ed25519` key
- **GPG keys stay valid** - All your past commits remain verified
- **It's just a config change** - Switch signing method in `.gitconfig`
- **You can use both** - Different repos can use different methods (via conditional includes)

## What Would Change

```ini
# Current (GPG)
[user]
    signingkey = F326797C8CFD28B4924505C58AE7900A1987367F
[commit]
    gpgsign = true

# SSH signing
[user]
    signingkey = ~/.ssh/github_ed25519.pub
[gpg]
    format = ssh
[commit]
    gpgsign = true
```

## One Extra Step

You'd need to add your SSH public key to GitHub as a **"Signing Key"** (it's currently only added as an "Authentication Key"):
- GitHub → Settings → SSH and GPG keys → New SSH key → Key type: **Signing Key**

# =============================================================================
# ~/.zshrc - Interactive Shell Configuration
# =============================================================================
# Note: Environment variables are now in ~/.zshenv (XDG compliant)

# Kiro CLI pre block. Keep at the top of this file.
[[ -f "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.pre.zsh" ]] && builtin source "${HOME}/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/shell/zshrc.pre.zsh"

# =============================================================================
# Powerlevel10k Instant Prompt (must be near top, after Kiro pre block)
# =============================================================================
if [[ -r "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/p10k-instant-prompt-${(%):-%n}.zsh" ]]; then
  source "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/p10k-instant-prompt-${(%):-%n}.zsh"
fi

# =============================================================================
# Plugin Manager Selection: zinit (testing) vs Oh My Zsh (fallback)
# =============================================================================
# Set to "zinit" to use zinit, or "omz" to use Oh My Zsh
PLUGIN_MANAGER="zinit"

if [[ "$PLUGIN_MANAGER" == "zinit" ]]; then
  # ===========================================================================
  # ZINIT Configuration (Turbo Mode - faster startup)
  # ===========================================================================
  ZINIT_HOME="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-${HOME}/.local/share}/zinit/zinit.git"

  # Auto-install zinit if not present
  if [[ ! -d "$ZINIT_HOME" ]]; then
    print -P "%F{33}Installing zinit...%f"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname $ZINIT_HOME)"
    git clone https://github.com/zdharma-continuum/zinit.git "$ZINIT_HOME"
  fi

  source "${ZINIT_HOME}/zinit.zsh"

  # Load Powerlevel10k immediately (needed for prompt)
  zinit ice depth=1
  zinit light romkatv/powerlevel10k

  # Turbo Mode: Load these plugins AFTER prompt appears (wait'0')
  # This makes your shell appear instantly, plugins load in background

  # Completions - load first for other plugins to use
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid blockf atpull'zinit creinstall -q .'
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-completions

  # Autosuggestions - fish-like suggestions
  # DISABLED: Conflicts with Kiro CLI's own autosuggestions integration
  # Kiro CLI wraps the same widgets causing infinite recursion
  # Uncomment below if you uninstall Kiro CLI or disable its shell integration
  #
  # export ZSH_AUTOSUGGEST_MANUAL_REBIND=1
  # zinit ice wait'0' lucid atload'_zsh_autosuggest_start'
  # zinit light zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions

  # Syntax highlighting - must be loaded after completions
  zinit ice wait'0' lucid atinit'zicompinit; zicdreplay'
  zinit light zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting

## Chezmoi Setup Complete

**Managed dotfiles:**
```
.zshrc, .zshenv, .zprofile          # Shell configs

.gitconfig                          # Main git config
.config/git/ignore                  # Global gitignore
Code/.../personal-projects/.gitconfig  # Personal git config
Code/.../elsevier-research/.gitconfig  # Work git config
.ssh/allowed_signers               # SSH signing keys
.config/bat/config                 # Bat config
.config/gh/config.yml              # GitHub CLI config
```

**Source directory:** `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`

### Common chezmoi commands:

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc` | Edit a file (opens VS Code) |
| `chezmoi diff` | Show pending changes |
| `chezmoi apply` | Apply changes to home dir |
| `chezmoi add ~/.file` | Add a new file to manage |
| `chezmoi cd` | Go to source directory |
| `chezmoi git status` | Check git status of dotfiles |
| `chezmoi update` | Pull and apply from remote |

### To push to a GitHub repo:
```bash
chezmoi cd
git remote add origin git@github.com:YOUR_USERNAME/dotfiles.git
git push -u origin main
```

---

## Summary of All Improvements Made

1. **Git config** - Best practices, SSH signing, performance opts, aliases
2. **Shell config** - XDG compliance, zinit turbo mode, lazy loading
3. **Global gitignore** - Comprehensive patterns for OS, editors, security
4. **SSH signing** - Configured with GPG as backup
5. **Cleanups** - Removed stale files, Rust toolchain (~513MB)
6. **Benchmark** - ~510ms startup (instant prompt makes it feel faster)
7. **chezmoi** - Dotfile management with version control

**Remaining manual step:** Add your SSH key to GitHub as a "Signing Key" at https://github.com/settings/keys to enable commit signature verification.

#!/bin/zsh
# .claude_profile - Minimal shell configuration for Claude Code
# Place this in your home directory: ~/.claude_profile

[[ ! -f $HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh ]] || source $HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh

# Your exact PATH setup from .zshrc
export HOME="/Users/rambhiad"
export PYTHON="/usr/bin/python3"
export OPENSSL="/usr/local/opt/openssl/bin"
export OPENSSH="/usr/local/bin/ssh:/usr/local/bin/ssh-add:/usr/local/bin/ssh-agent:/usr/local/bin/ssh-keygen:/usr/local/bin/ssh-keyscan:/usr/local/bin/sshfs"
export CURL="/usr/local/opt/curl/bin"
export GOPATH="$HOME/go"
export RUSTBIN="$HOME/.cargo/bin"
export PACTPATH="$HOME/.local/pact/bin"
export KREW_ROOT="$HOME/.krew"
export CODEQL_CLI="$HOME/.local/codeql"
export M2_HOME="$HOME/.m2"

# Your exact PATH from .zshrc
export PATH="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin"
export PATH="$CURL:$PATH:$PYTHON:$OPENSSL:$OPENSSH:$GOPATH/bin:$RUSTBIN"
export PATH="$PATH:$JAVA_HOME:$PACTPATH"
export PATH="$PATH:/Users/rambhiad/.local/bin"
export PATH="$PATH:$KREW_ROOT/bin"
export PATH="$PATH:$CODEQL_CLI"
export PATH="$PATH:$M2_HOME/bin"

# Python version manager (pyenv) - from your config
if command -v pyenv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    export PYENV_ROOT="$HOME/.pyenv"
    export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH"
    eval "$(pyenv init -)"
fi

# SDKMAN - from your config
export SDKMAN_DIR="$HOME/.sdkman"
[[ -s "$HOME/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh" ]] && source "$HOME/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"

# AWS CLI completion - from your config
if type aws_completer > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    complete -C "$(which aws_completer)" aws
fi

# Essential environment variables
export EDITOR="code --wait"  # From your config
export LANG="en_US.UTF-8"
export LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"

# Certificate bundle from your config
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/Users/rambhiad/ca-certs/Zscaler-Root-CA.pem

# CRITICAL: Disable zoxide cd override and ensure builtin cd works
unalias cd 2>/dev/null || true
unfunction cd 2>/dev/null || true

# Ensure cd works as expected (builtin command)
cd() {
    builtin cd "$@"
}

# Safe aliases from your config (without the problematic ones)
alias k='kubectl'  # Your kubectl alias
alias t='terraform'  # Your terraform alias

# Useful aliases that won't cause issues
alias ll='ls -la'  # Simplified version without eza dependency
alias la='ls -A'
alias l='ls -CF'
alias rmdsstores='find ./ -type f | grep .DS_Store | xargs rm'

# Git aliases
alias gs='git status'
alias ga='git add'
alias gc='git commit'
alias gp='git push'
alias gl='git pull'

# Directory navigation helpers (without zoxide)
alias ..='cd ..'
alias ...='cd ../..'
alias ....='cd ../../..'

# Utility functions
mkcd() {
    mkdir -p "$1" && cd "$1"
}

# AWS function from your aliases
awsd() {
    source _awsd
}

# Docker completion from your config
fpath=(/Users/rambhiad/.docker/completions $fpath)
if command -v compinit >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    autoload -Uz compinit
    compinit -d "$HOME/.zcompdump-claude" 2>/dev/null
fi

# Tailscale alias from your config
alias tailscale="/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale"

echo "Claude Code profile loaded successfully (zoxide disabled, cd working)"

# .claude_profile - Shell configuration for Claude Code
# This file is sourced by Claude Code for its shell environment

# =============================================================================

# AWS CLI completion (zsh-style)
